title: Sensitivity of Antibiotics for Urinary Tract Infections Patients Attending Family Physicians
brief_summary: This study is aiming to evaluate the sensitivity of uropathogens isolated in patients with community acquired UTI with Enoxacin in comparison to other antimicrobials. While Secondary objective is to study the spectrum of uropathogens responsible for community acquired UTI in local population
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Samples from primary care clinics from patients who reports UTI symptoms and in which uropathogens are isolated will be included.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Samples from specialized, hospitalized or catheterized patients.
